title: Poll suggests most Londoners want Mayor Sadiq Khan to step down
summary: A poll indicates that a majority of Londoners wish for Mayor Sadiq Khan not to contest a fourth term in office. The survey results suggest that most residents of London prefer Khan to stand down before the next mayoral election. The findings were reported by The Daily Telegraph and the Evening Standard.
summary_points: A poll indicates most Londoners want Mayor Sadiq Khan to step down.
The survey suggests a majority do not want him to contest a fourth mayoral election.
The findings were reported by The Daily Telegraph and the Evening Standard.

इन निष्कर्षों की रिपोर्ट द डेली टेलीग्राफ और इवनिंग स्टैंडर्ड ने दी है।
